info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Points-v2-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about loyalty points accumulated by customers. It serves as a vital resource for businesses to understand customer engagement and reward distribution. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and marketing teams who use this data for customer interactions and targeted promotions. By querying this endpoint, businesses can effectively track and manage loyalty programs, enhancing customer satisfaction and retention.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve their current loyalty points balance and related information. It provides a simple way for users to check their points accumulation and any applicable rewards.
